relevance_note: A CVID cohort WES study describing one patient with a TNFAIP3 variant: "A variant in the tumor necrosis factor, alpha-induced protein (TNFAIP)3 gene (c.997dupG) resulting in a frameshift (p.A333fs^*2) was found in P10".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; JSON built with a short Python script from hand-chosen values, spans checked by script. Scope: of the 20 sequenced CVID patients only P10 carries a TNFAIP3 variant; the other 19 get no rows (cohort_size_as_stated = 20). Relatives: Supplementary Table S3 (PDF text conversion, column 'Predispositions') lists for row 10 'mother: asthma, thyroiditis. Father: DMII'; the cell text is split over several lines by the conversion, so spans are separate fragments; assignment to row 10 is from the line layout (the row-10 line holds 'thyroiditis. Father:'). These untested relatives are included as 'mother of P10' and 'father of P10'. Thyroiditis is not stated to be autoimmune, so 'autoimmune thyroiditis' is left not reported for the mother; DMII (type 2) does not address type 1 diabetes. P10 cytopenias (anemia, thrombocytopenia, pancytopenia) are not described as autoimmune (thrombocytopenia improved after splenectomy for hypersplenism), so 'cytopenia (autoimmune)' is not reported; splenomegaly/hepatosplenomegaly with portal hypertension is not described as lymphoproliferation, so that checklist item is not reported. Zygosity heterozygous for the TNFAIP3 variant is taken from the title of Table 2 ('Monoallelic variants identified') covering P10's row; IL2RG c.-83G>A (Table S2, considered unlikely disease-causing) is recorded as a second variant for P10 with zygosity from the S2 caption ('all variants are heterozygous except one homozygous variant found in P4'). Pathogenicity 'likely pathogenic' comes from the abstract naming TNFAIP3 among the likely pathogenic variants; Table 2 ACMG column shows '4' (not defined in the paper). Table 3 inheritance 'Unknown'; inheritance not reported. The functional statement about a truncated, degraded protein refers to the previously reported p.A332X, not P10's variant; the authors state no functional validation was done, so functional evidence is not reported. Laboratory values from Table 4 and S4 recorded only where a definition or reference interval is printed (IgA BD, IgG 4.2 vs 6.9-15.7 g/L, class-switched memory B 0.6% vs 4.8-28); lymphocyte subset counts below reference (e.g. lymphocytes 266) and faecal calprotectin 1266 (no reference printed) and sputum microbiology (H. influenzae, Moraxella, VZV, GBS; text split across lines) were not made into feature rows. Age at diagnosis 23 from Table 1 (unit not printed, years assumed for ISO); 'diagnosed with CVID 10 years ago' gives no current age. No contradictions found. cites_prior_report left null: the paper says it continues earlier studies of the Danish CVID cohort but does not say these patients were described before.
